## Production Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Lirat (FinTech & Currency Tracking)
- Category: FinTech / SaaS Mobile Application
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, Clean Architecture, BLoC, Dio, Hive, WebSockets, Secure Storage
- Overview: Real-time currency exchange tracker and financial portfolio app delivering millisecond-accurate exchange rates, cross-currency conversion engines, and multi-asset tracking under volatile macroeconomic conditions.
- Architectural Highlights: Local-first caching with Hive, resilient WebSocket reconnection fallback to exponential backoff HTTP polling, and secure biometric token persistence.

### 2. P2P Syria (Peer-to-Peer Financial Transfer Network)
- Category: FinTech / Peer-to-Peer Transactions
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, Clean Architecture, BLoC, Dio, Local Authentication, Secure Storage
- Overview: Secure decentralized peer-to-peer transaction and escrow coordination network engineered for secure fund exchange and verification.
- Architectural Highlights: Client-side cryptographic signature verification, zero-leak local storage, anti-tamper security checks, and strict idempotency tokens on network requests.

### 3. Card App (Digital Payment & Gift Card Voucher Marketplace)
- Category: E-Commerce / Digital Payments
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, BLoC, In-App Purchases, Payment Gateways, Dio, Secure Storage
- Overview: Digital payment, gift card, and gaming voucher marketplace offering instant redemption codes, multi-currency wallet management, and secure checkout.

### 4. White-Label E-Commerce Multi-Tenant Framework
- Category: Multi-Tenant Architecture / Enterprise Mobile
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, Clean Architecture, Dynamic Theming, Modular Packages, Fastlane
- Overview: Enterprise white-label framework powering multiple live storefronts across Saudi Arabia from a unified core codebase. Reduced new tenant release cycles by over 80%.

### 5. Hardware POS / ECR Mobile Integration
- Category: POS & Hardware SDKs / Enterprise Retail
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Android Platform Channels, SUNMI SDK, ESC/POS, Thermal Printing, USB/Serial
- Overview: Retail POS workstation running on SUNMI Android hardware with customer dual-display synchronization, hardware barcode scanning, and ESC/POS thermal printing.
